# POLYROB configuration (index)

Read the ONE area file you need with `read_skill_resource` — never all of them.
Generated from `docs/CONFIGURATION.md` and `core/config_policy`.

## How a setting is set

- Env files, highest first (`core/paths.py`): the process env (on a server the service unit loads `/etc/polyrob/polyrob.env` into it) > the instance file `<data home>/.env` (a deployed box) > `~/.polyrob/.env` > legacy `~/.rob/.env`. A project `.env`, `./.polyrob/.env` or `config/.env.*` is never read. An env setting applies at the next restart (`/restart`).
- A posture member is set ONLY with `polyrob config set NAME true|false` (a terminal command) or a `POLYROB_OVERRIDES=NAME=true,OTHER=false` line in the env file; a plain `NAME=true` env line is IGNORED. `propose_setting` files the line for the owner. The member list: `references/config/posture-bundles-derived-defaults.md`.
- The owner sets a console setting with `/config set NAME value` on a chat seat or `polyrob config set NAME value` in a terminal; you file one with `propose_setting`.

## The autonomy dial

Out of the box you are interactive: you act on the owner's messages and on
nothing else. Autonomy is opt-in. The axes, in the order the owner sets them:

1. `POLYROB_LOCAL` — default: OFF — the single-user profile; the CLI sets it. Turns on its member group.
2. `AUTONOMY_ENABLED` — default: OFF (ON under AUTONOMY_MODE=autonomous or AUTONOMY_POSTURE owner-visible/full) — the master switch for the self-directed loops (self-wake, goal board, curator, background review, writable skills). Needs `POLYROB_LOCAL`.
3. `AUTONOMY_POSTURE` (silent | owner-visible | full) — default: silent — how verified and visible the autonomous work is; `full` adds the scheduler (jobs) and the no-change wake gate.
4. `AUTONOMY_MODE` (supervised | autonomous) — default: supervised — `autonomous` = act and report on a single-owner box; needs `POLYROB_LOCAL` and a bound owner, else it clamps to `supervised`.
5. `AGENT_COMPUTE_POSTURE` (0 | 1 | 2 | 3) — default: 0 — host capability: 0 confined sandbox, 1 persistent dev sandbox, 2 self-maintenance (`self_env`), 3 host.

Axis 3 or 4 turns axis 2 on by itself. Money, host access and secrets keep their own gates under every setting.

How the owner moves it: `polyrob autonomy status|on|off` (`polyrob autonomy on --mode autonomous`) in a terminal; `/autonomy on|off` in the terminal REPL (applies at once); `/mode` on every seat shows the effective setting and how to change it. Read this session's live value with `agent_status`.

## Run limits

A run stops honestly at the first limit it reaches and says which one.

- `INTERACTIVE_MAX_STEPS` — default: 100 — steps of an owner turn, a REPL turn, `polyrob run`, the API and A2A
- `AUTONOMOUS_MAX_STEPS` — default: 150 — steps of one autonomous run: goal, job, helper
- `AUTONOMOUS_RUN_BUDGET_USD` — default: 2.0 (0 = off) — AI cost of one autonomous run (stop reason `run_budget`)
- `RUN_BUDGET_USD` — default: 0 (disabled) — AI cost of one session, any run

The credit sentinel (`CREDIT_SENTINEL_ENABLED`) stops autonomous runs after a real provider billing failure; wallet spend has its own limits (`references/money-and-safety.md`).
